name: Vacation Checklist
description: A vacation checklist for planning a leisure getaway, covering itinerary, bookings, budget, and home prep so you can relax once you arrive.

faq.q: How is a vacation checklist different from a travel checklist?
faq.a: A vacation checklist leans into planning a relaxing getaway — itinerary, dining, downtime, and budget — while a travel checklist is broader logistics for any trip. Use this for leisure planning and a travel checklist for the full nuts-and-bolts.

faq.q: How far ahead should I plan a vacation?
faq.a: Begin four to eight weeks out for most getaways, and earlier for peak seasons or popular destinations. Early planning locks in better prices on stays and lets you snap up sought-after restaurants and activities.

faq.q: Should this list include what to pack?
faq.a: No. Keep packing on its own list so this one stays focused on planning. Use a vacation packing checklist for clothes, toiletries, and gear once your itinerary is set.

faq.q: How do I budget for a vacation?
faq.a: Set a total budget, then split it across transport, accommodation, food, activities, and a buffer for extras. Tracking spending day to day helps you enjoy the trip without an unwelcome surprise on your return.
